```{python}
carpall = carpall[carpall.obs["avg_pseudotime_scaled"].notna()].copy()

pk = cr.kernels.PseudotimeKernel(carpall, time_key="avg_pseudotime_scaled")
pk.compute_transition_matrix(threshold_scheme="soft")
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd

# Regex matches gene names starting with MT-, RPL, RPS, MRPL, or MRPS (case-insensitive)
pattern = r"^(?:MT-|M?RP[LS])"

mask = ~early_driver_df.index.astype(str).str.contains(pattern, case=False, regex=True)
early_driver_df_filtered = early_driver_df[mask]

# Map onto the driver DataFrame by gene name
early_driver_df_filtered["mean expression"] = (
    carpall.var.loc[early_driver_df_filtered.index, "mean expression"]
)

early_df_expr = early_driver_df_filtered[early_driver_df_filtered["mean expression"] >= 0.1].copy()
early_df_expr["log1p mean expression"] = np.log1p(early_df_expr["mean expression"])
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
sc = ax.scatter(
    x=early_df_expr["Late: DN T_1_corr"],
    y=early_df_expr["Early: CD8 TCM_1_corr"],
    c=early_df_expr["log1p mean expression"],
    cmap="magma",
    s=5,
    alpha=0.8,
)
fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, label="log1p(mean expression)")

ax.axhline(y=0, color="red", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")  # geom_hline

ax.set_xlabel("Correlation with DN T fate")
ax.set_ylabel("Correlation with EM CD8+ T fate")
ax.set_title("Driver gene correlations (mean expression >= 0.1)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# correlate driver gene expression with fate decision of cells

```{python}
# 1. Pull the raw matrix
lineages_data = carpall.obsm["lineages_fwd"]

# 2. Build the dataframe using the helper properties built into the Lineage object
lineage_fate = pd.DataFrame(
    lineages_data,
    index=carpall.obs_names,   # Assign cell barcodes to rows
    columns=lineages_data.names # Pull column names directly from the object
)
```

```{python}
# Flatten the list if it was accidentally nested
# (e.g., if candidate_names was already a list, writing [candidate_names] nested it)
genes_of_interest = candidate_names if isinstance(candidate_names, list) else list(candidate_names)

# Alternatively, if you manually typed them, make sure it looks like this:
# genes_of_interest = ["Gene1", "Gene2", "Gene3"]

# Loop through and add each gene as a new column
for gene in genes_of_interest:
    if gene in carpall.var_names:
        lineage_fate[gene] = carpall.obs_vector(gene)
    else:
        print(f"Warning: {gene} not found in dataset columns (var_names)")
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1. Pull the raw matrix
lineages_data = carpall.obsm["lineages_fwd"]

# 2. Build the initial single-cell dataframe
lineage_fate = pd.DataFrame(
    lineages_data,
    index=carpall.obs_names,
    columns=lineages_data.names
)

# 3. Add metadata needed for grouping (e.g., patient ID)
# Replace 'patient_id' with the exact column name used in your carpall.obs
lineage_fate["patient_id"] = carpall.obs["Patient"]

# 4. Add genes of interest
genes_of_interest = candidate_names if isinstance(candidate_names, list) else list(candidate_names)
for gene in genes_of_interest:
    if gene in carpall.var_names:
        lineage_fate[gene] = carpall.obs_vector(gene)
    else:
        print(f"Warning: {gene} not found in dataset columns (var_names)")

# 5. AGGREGATE TO PATIENT LEVEL
# This groups by patient and averages all numeric columns (fates and genes)
patient_level_df = lineage_fate.groupby("patient_id").mean().reset_index()

# 6. Plot at the Patient Level
plt.close("all")
sns.lmplot(
    data=patient_level_df,  # Using the aggregated patient dataframe
    x="Late: DN T_1",
    y="TMSB10",
    height=4,
    scatter_kws={"s": 100, "alpha": 1}  # Increased point size since there are fewer dots
)
```

```{python}
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

goi = "BTF3"
fate = "Mid: CD8 TEM"

# Generate the plot
plt.close("all")
g = sns.lmplot(
    data=patient_level_df,
    x=fate,
    y=goi,
    height=4,
    scatter_kws={"s": 50, "alpha": 1}
)

# Calculate stats for annotation
clean_df = patient_level_df[[fate, goi]].dropna()
rho, p_val = stats.spearmanr(clean_df[fate], clean_df[goi])

# Create text string - properly escaping the LaTeX code
stats_text = f"$\\rho$ = {rho:.2f}\n$p$ = {p_val:.3e}"

# Add text box to the plot
ax = g.ax # Get the underlying matplotlib axis
ax.text(
    0.05, 0.95, stats_text, 
    transform=ax.transAxes, 
    verticalalignment='top',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', facecolor='white', alpha=0.5)
)
```
